name: cuotas-club
description: Sistema de gestión de cuotas para Osorno Runners

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
